title: Camera attempting file recovery
shortDescription: HERO is repairing an interrupted recording.
fullDescription: HERO 10/11/12 show the SOS icon when power was lost mid-record or a file is corrupt. The camera tries to repair automatically; press any button to start repair. If repeated, replace SD card with a recommended V30+ model.

fixSteps.title: Let SOS complete
fixSteps.instruction: Do not power off; wait up to 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Use recommended card
fixSteps.instruction: SanDisk Extreme V30 or Lexar Professional 1066x.

whenToCallPro: Never needed; replace card if persistent.

title: Overheating shutdown
shortDescription: HERO stops recording to protect itself.
fullDescription: 5.3K60 and 4K120 on HERO 11/12 generate substantial heat, especially in still air. The camera auto-shuts at its thermal limit. Mounting on moving gear, removing from sun, or using the Max Lens Mod reduces heat build-up.

fixSteps.title: Cool the camera
fixSteps.instruction: Remove from sun, open battery door briefly, wait 10 min.

faq.a: Enduro runs slightly cooler, especially in cold.

title: SD card not recognized
shortDescription: Camera does not detect the card.
fullDescription: GoPro requires a V30+ microSD. Non-recommended, counterfeit, or worn cards cause this. Format in-camera with a genuine card.

fixSteps.title: Try recommended card
fixSteps.instruction: SanDisk Extreme V30 128GB or similar on GoPro list.

title: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi pairing failure
fullDescription: iOS 17 and Android 14 added local-network permissions that block the GoPro Quik app. Ensure the app has both Bluetooth and Local Network access. Reset connections on the camera.

fixSteps.title: Grant app permissions
fixSteps.instruction: Phone Settings > Quik > enable Bluetooth and Local Network.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Open Quik > Add Camera > follow prompts.

faq.a: Yes for firmware updates and cloud upload.

title: Battery won't hold charge or rapid drain
shortDescription: Enduro/standard battery near end of life.
fullDescription: GoPro Enduro batteries last ~500 cycles. Cold shortens runtime; cold-performance is the Enduro's specialty. Replace if shows full then crashes to 0.

faq.a: Enduro adds cold performance and ~40% longer run.

title: Max Lens Mod communication failure
fullDescription: Max Lens Mod 2.0 requires HERO 11/12/13 with the supported firmware. If not detected, remove, clean contacts, and ensure firmware is current.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Max Lens Mod
fixSteps.instruction: Clean threads and O-ring, retighten gently.

videoSearchQuery: GoPro Max Lens Mod not detected fix

faq.a: No, HERO 13 uses Max Lens Mod 2.0.

title: Frozen UI — force reset
shortDescription: Hold Mode button 10s to force reboot.
fullDescription: When the HERO UI freezes, hold the Mode button for 10 seconds. This cuts power safely without pulling the battery.
videoSearchQuery: GoPro frozen reset hold mode fix

faq.a: No, a force reset preserves settings.

title: Firmware update interrupted
shortDescription: Update via SD card or Quik failed.
fullDescription: Low battery, removed card, or interrupted app session can fail an update. Do manual SD card update with a freshly formatted card and >75% battery.

fixSteps.title: Manual SD card update
fixSteps.instruction: Download .zip, extract UPDATE folder to card root, insert, power on.

whenToCallPro: If camera bricked and manual update fails, GoPro support.
videoSearchQuery: GoPro firmware update failed manual fix

faq.a: Older firmware bundles are posted on GoPro community forums.

title: Mic channel silent or quiet
shortDescription: Water or debris in mic ports, or Media Mod not detected.
fullDescription: Water entering mic ports makes recordings quiet or muffled until it dries. Media Mod users need firmware support and proper seating. Drain-and-dry commonly restores mics.

fixSteps.title: Drain and dry
fixSteps.instruction: Shake out, let air-dry 24h in rice or silica.

fixSteps.title: Check Media Mod firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Update both camera and Media Mod.

whenToCallPro: If audio still bad after drying.

faq.a: Silica packs are better; rice is okay in a pinch.

title: HyperSmooth Horizon Lock greyed out
fullDescription: Horizon Lock/Level only works in supported resolutions and FOVs. 360 Horizon Lock requires Linear or Wide, specific frame rates.

fixSteps.title: Change to Linear + Wide
fixSteps.instruction: Set 4K60 Linear for HyperSmooth Pro + 360 Horizon Lock.

videoSearchQuery: GoPro 360 Horizon Lock greyed out fix

faq.a: 360 Horizon Lock is limited to 4K and below.

title: GPS telemetry missing from clips
fullDescription: GPS takes up to 2 minutes under clear sky. Indoor use or dense buildings block lock. Toggle GPS off/on and allow 2-minute sky time before recording.
symptoms: Empty GPS data in Quik overlays

faq.a: HERO 12 removed GPS; it is back on HERO 13.
